notes: Early high range, mid-year slide and capitulation wick, V recovery to near prior highs, then one large down gap and partial rebound to MA50/MA200 cluster. Choppy.
Uptrend then 6-month top range, then sharp decline to new lows on rising volume; last ~15 bars bounce off the low. MA50 rolling over below a now-falling MA200.
Persistent staircase uptrend all year, higher highs and higher lows, shallow pullbacks to MA50; decision bar gaps up to a new 252-session high. Volume unremarkable.
Opens with a crash from the year's high, mid-year recovery, then a slow lower-highs decline to near the year's low; MA50 below falling MA200.
Down gap and slide early, V recovery with up gap, uptrend into a choppy range near highs; last bars: one-day spike to a new high immediately reversed back to MA50.
Large down gap early, base, slow uptrend with MA50 crossing MA200; ~20 bars before the end a large up gap on heavy volume to a new year high, held and drifted sideways near the top.
Range, then mid-year crash and double bottom on heavy volume, gap-up V recovery, then staircase higher to a new year high at the decision bar; volume calmer in the advance.
Flat range, brief spike high mid-year, then lower highs and a sharp capitulation leg; final bars rebound back to the falling MA50 on heavier volume.
Gap-driven chart: gap up to a plateau, gap down, then a very large gap down on the year's heaviest volume; afterwards a 4-month base and a gradual rise above MA50, still below MA200.
Long decline to a capitulation low, gap-up reversal on heavy volume, then a steady lower-volatility staircase advance; decision bar in a shallow pullback touching the rising MA50 just below the high.
Gap-down crash early, recovery to a year high, then a gap-led decline to a double bottom; last two months a steady rally back up to the falling MA200 (MA50 still below MA200).

Flat-to-down first third ending in a high-volume capitulation low, V recovery, then a long orderly staircase uptrend with pullbacks holding the rising MA50; decision bar a shallow dip just below the high.
High range, gap down, then a long lower-highs decline; final four months a sideways base around a flattening MA50 well below the falling MA200.
Early decline (one huge-volume bar), long base, gradual uptrend; last ~2 months an accelerating leg with an up gap to new highs far above the MA50, then a tight pause at the top.
Volatile swings all year: rally, drop to a wick low, rise to year high, gap down from the top, sharp drop, rebound to MA200 with MA50 falling above. No coherent structure at the decision point.
Choppy year with a deep mid-year drop and partial recoveries; recent large up move on a volume spike, partly given back. Range-bound, no clear setup.

Strong uptrend and gap up in the first third, then eight months of very volatile sideways trading with crash wicks, a gap up to a new high, a gap down, and a final-bar large up gap. High volatility, no clean structure.
Volatile swings: early low, rally to a gap-up spike high, slump, recovery to a top range for four months, then a break below MA50 and MA200 to the middle of the range; small bounce at the end.
Base, gap-up breakout, strong advance to a blow-off top, crash wick, lower second top, gap down, then a slow lower-highs decline; decision bar breaking below the rising MA200 to a new post-top low.
Gap-up spike to the year high, drift lower, gap-down crash, partial recovery, second sell-off on volume; last two months a rally back above the MA50, still below the falling MA200.
Strong first-half uptrend, top range, then lower highs below a flattening MA200; final 3 bars a very large up gap on heavy volume back above MA200 (fresh gap; hold not yet established).
Strong uptrend for seven months, then a five-month high plateau with a flattening MA50; recent wide-range spike up and drop back to the MA50 on rising volume.
Early jump, eight-month range above a rising MA200, then a breakout to new highs in the last three months with a steepening MA50; decision bar at the high.
Orderly year-long uptrend with up gaps and higher lows; last month a pullback to the rising MA50 and a two-bar bounce back toward the high.
Early drop, base, then a year of higher highs with a choppy middle (one crash wick on heavy volume); last month a steep leg to new highs well above MA50, small pause at the top.
Early gap up off a low, range, rally to a year high, gap down and drop to MA200; last month a rebound back above MA50 and MA200 toward the upper range. Choppy.
Decline to a double bottom, steady recovery and uptrend, spike to a year high, then three months sideways around a flattening MA50 near the top.
Uptrend in steps; a push to a new high then a one-bar large drop to MA200; last month a modest recovery between MA200 and MA50 with lower highs. Trend intact on MA200, losing momentum.
Rise to a mid-year high, decline with lower highs, capitulation leg to a new low, then a sharp V rally on rising volume back to the flattening MA200.
Top in the first third, large gap down, collapse to a low on heavy volume, rebound, then six months of a tightening sideways base around a flat MA50 below the falling MA200.
Year-long range between two highs, then a steep breakdown (about a third of value) on rising volume to a capitulation wick; small bounce at the decision bar.
Decline to a low, gap-up recovery, base above MA200, then a series of up gaps (stair steps) to new highs with tight consolidations between; decision bar at the high.
Ten months of wide range with gap-down shakeouts, then a very large gap down (about a third) on heavy volume, a brief stall and a further decline to a new low; MA50 collapsing below MA200.
Year-long rising channel with higher highs; last two months a choppy pullback below the flattening MA50 with a wide-range final bar (long upper wick), still well above the rising MA200.
Very volatile: surge to an early high, long decline, then two sharp rallies (each about +40%) separated by a drop; decision bar a pullback from the latest high, above both MAs.
Two-thirds strong orderly uptrend, then a rounded top and five months of lower highs; MA50 has fallen to meet the rising MA200; price whipsawing around both.
Uptrend to a high, then a sharp collapse through MA50 and MA200 on rising volume (about -40% from the top) with a high-volume low and a weak bounce.
Volatile uptrend with large swings; five-month top range, then a break below MA50 and the rising MA200; drifting lower at the decision bar.
Early decline to a low, then a long orderly advance; four-month flat consolidation along MA50, then a renewed leg to new highs; decision bar at the high on rising volume.
Low early, strong uptrend to a double top, volatile pullback with a crash wick to MA200, then recovery back above both MAs toward the highs.

Early top, steep decline to a capitulation low on heavy volume, recovery, a gap-down shakeout, then a second recovery; MA50 crossed above the falling MA200; last two months a tight sideways range near the recovery high.
Uptrend to a high, steep decline through MA200, base, gap-up recovery to MA200, pullback to MA50 and a final up bar. Volatile, no clean structure.
Persistent year-long downtrend with lower highs below a falling MA200; last month a rally above the MA50 on higher volume (first higher low in a while).
Range with an early crash wick, dip and recovery, uptrend, gap up to a new high and a three-month high plateau; last few bars a sharp gap down below the MA50 and a partial rebound.
Early high, a gap-down collapse to a low, recovery with gaps to a range around MA200, then an up gap to the upper range about two weeks ago, now fading. Low base volume with isolated spikes.
Gap-down early, range, second slide to a low, strong V uptrend to new highs; one huge-volume day compresses the volume panel; last bars a sharp drop and immediate recovery to the high.
Base, gap-up breakout, long uptrend to a high, then a top and a decline through the rising MA200 to new post-top lows; MA50 now meeting MA200.
Uptrend to a high, gap down below MA50, six months of range near MA50, then a steep decline to a new low on rising volume.
Strong uptrend with gaps to a high, then a lower-highs decline through MA200 ending in a gap-down capitulation bar; immediate violent V rally back above MA200, now pulling back to it.
Orderly uptrend with a large up gap mid-year; last two months a pullback below the flattening MA50, held at the rising MA200, and a bounce with a small gap.
Gap-driven chart: early top, gap up to a second top, gap down, decline, gap-down low; last five months a choppy sideways range around a flat MA50 below a falling MA200.
Early capitulation wick at MA200 on high volume, then an orderly ten-month uptrend; last three months a sideways consolidation hugging the flattening MA50 just below the high.
Volatile uptrend: rally, range with a dip to MA200, gap-up surge to a high, gap down, sideways around MA50, recent push back toward the upper range.
Early decline to a low, gap-up recovery, then a long sideways base; MA50 and MA200 converged and flat; last bars a small up move above both.
High range, sharp decline through MA200 to a low on heavy volume, then a V recovery back to the falling MA200, where the last bars stall and turn down.
Very volatile: repeated rallies and steep drops (two crash wicks); MA50 crossed above MA200; recent push to near the high then a sharp one-day drop to MA200.
Cyclical swings with lower highs: early top, deep drop, recovery to MA200, rally to a lower high, then a gap-down decline to a new low; last bars a bounce.
High early, slow decline, a sudden gap-down crash on record volume, sharp recovery and a slow climb back; MA50 rising to meet a falling MA200; last bars a dip to the MA cluster.
Year-long uptrend with higher highs; recent push to a new high, then the decision bar gaps down sharply on the year's heaviest volume toward the MA50 (possible news shock).
Gap-assisted uptrend in steps with a dip to MA200 mid-year; recent consolidation then a surge on the year's heaviest volume to a new high at the decision bar.
Base, high-volume gap-up breakout, persistent eight-month uptrend in gap-led steps; recent narrowing consolidation along the rising MA50 with the decision bar at a new high.
Orderly year-long uptrend in steps; last month a large up gap on heavy volume to a new high, held and extended with a final strong bar; well above MA50.
Base, uptrend with a large up-gap spike high on heavy volume, then six months of a volatile top range; decision bar a drop below the flattening MA50 to the rising MA200.
Year-long orderly uptrend with a mid-year range along the MA50, then a renewed leg; recent small gap up to a new high.
Dip to MA200 with a crash wick, then a steep three-month advance, then six months of a wide volatile range at the top along a flattening MA50; recent push to the top of the range.
Early high, gap down and long lower-highs decline to a rounded bottom; MA50 turning up; last two months a rally above the falling MA200 to a higher high (first one in the year).
Gap-dominated chart: gap up to an early high, gap down, gap-down low, rally, gap up, decline, chop; final bar up through the converging MAs. No coherent structure.
Strong orderly uptrend for two-thirds of the year, then a correction to below MA50 and a four-month base under the high; last bars pressing back to near the high above the rising MA50.
Uptrend interrupted by a dip to MA200, renewed advance to a high, correction to MA200, recovery to near the high; decision bars a small pullback.
Flat first half, steep decline to a low on rising volume, then a stair-step recovery; last two months a steady rally above the MA200 to near the year high; MA50 about to cross the flat MA200.
Slow ten-month uptrend, a blow-off spike high on record volume, then a collapse through MA200 to a low below the year's start; last bars a rebound on rising volume.
Range, then a deep decline on rising volume, V recovery with an up gap back above MA200; last two months a sideways range just below the earlier range highs.
Uptrend to an early-year top, long decline through MA200 to a double bottom, then a rising base and a breakout above the flat MA200 with a steep last-month rally to the highest level since the top.
Top early, persistent lower-highs decline below a falling MA200; last month a large gap down on the year's heaviest volume to a new low.
Year-long volatile range with a crash wick, a spike high, a decline through MA200, a new capitulation low on heavy volume and a sharp two-week rebound to the falling MA50.
Steep early decline, long sideways range under MA200, gap down to a new low, then a sharp recovery rally above both MAs in the last month on rising volume.
Choppy first half, a sharp decline to a low on heavy volume, recovery, uptrend to a new year high, then a modest pullback to the MA50.
Early uptrend to a high, single huge gap down (largest volume), decline, recovery, then a sideways range around flat converging MAs with another gap down and recovery. No structure.
Gap-driven: early top, gap downs to a flat base at the low, a gap-up surge, a further gap up on record volume, then three months of a very tight sideways range well above MA200.
Orderly year-long uptrend with a high-volume gap-up step mid-year; last month a sharp drop below the flattening MA50 and a partial recovery back to it.
Year-long uptrend in steps with gaps and a mid-year shakeout; recent sharp dip below MA50 recovered to a new high, now drifting sideways at the flattening MA50.
Early surge to a high, volatile decline to a capitulation low, V recovery and a three-month base around the flat MA200, then a steady four-month advance to new highs.
Gap-heavy volatile chart: early gap-down crashes, range below falling MA200, base, gap-up breakout above MA200 and an uptrend to new highs; last bars a pullback to the MA50.
Gap down early, decline, a huge gap-down crash on the heaviest volume, low, six months of a weak recovery capped by the falling MA200, then a slide to a new low.
Rally to a mid-year high, steep decline to a low, steady recovery above MA200, then an advance to new highs with a tight three-week flag at the top.
Low early, steady uptrend to a high, then a lower-highs decline through MA200 on rising volume; MA50 crossing below MA200 at the decision point.
Strong uptrend with a large gap up mid-year to a high; three-month top, then a break below MA50 and now slightly below the rising MA200.
Persistent orderly uptrend all year with a high-volume shakeout and recovery mid-year; one gap down near the high recovered; recent tight range along the MA50 with the decision bar at a new high.
Early dip to MA200 on high volume, then an orderly eight-month uptrend in steps; last month a sharp drop below the MA50 and a partial rebound.
Seven months of choppy range around MA200 with a crash wick and a dip, then a gap-up recovery and a steady four-month advance to new highs.
Flat range for four months, gap down, decline, a second large gap down, then a weak sideways drift at the lows with a crash wick; lower highs throughout.
Gap-down staircase decline, a large gap-down capitulation on the heaviest volume, then a slow six-month base and recovery back to the falling MA200 with low volume.
Rising swings with higher highs to a top, then a sharp drop below MA200; last month a rally back above MA200 toward the falling MA50.
Decline to a low, recovery through MA200, choppy uptrend to a new high, pullback to MA200 and a final up move back to the MA50.
Low early, strong advance to a double top, then a lower-highs decline through MA200 (MA50 crossing below); last month a small base and bounce.
Eight months of choppy range around MA200, then a gap-up and a strong uptrend; the last month an accelerating leg to new highs well above the MA50.
Very volatile oscillation all year: drop, rally to spike highs, slide, crash wick, rally, slide; decision bar a wide-range down bar under the MAs. No usable structure.
Gap-led uptrend above a rising MA200: dip, rally, pullback to MA200, rally, a large up gap on heavy volume to a new high, then a two-month pullback below MA50 and a small bounce.
Gap-down staircase decline to a low, recovery back to the falling MA200 that failed (gap down), then a drift lower to the lower range.
Low early, flat range, gap-up step to a high plateau, a blow-off spike top, then a decline through MA200 with a crash wick; decision bar at a new post-top low.
Early dip, gap-up turn and an orderly uptrend with higher highs; three-month consolidation along MA50, then a push to a new high at the decision bar.
Top early, lower highs below a falling MA200 with spike rallies on heavy volume that fail; last month a slide to a new low.
Uptrend to a mid-year high, decline through MA200 to a low, higher low, then a steady rally back above the falling MA200 with a final jump.
High range, gap-down decline, second gap-down leg, a low, a gap-up recovery on record volume, base, then a steady rally above the rising MA50 toward the falling MA200.
Very volatile range with gap-driven swings; rally to near the range top in the last two months, then a sharp drop below both converged MAs at the decision bar.
High-volatility wide-range bars all year: early high, decline to a capitulation wick, rally to a high, then slow lower-highs drift below the MAs. No clear setup.
Rising swings with crash wicks to an early-second-half high, then a volatile top range; last bars a drop below converged MA50 / MA200.
Early decline to a low at MA200, steady uptrend to a high, correction to MA200, gap-up recovery and a renewed advance to new highs.
Very orderly year-long uptrend along MA50 with a gap up mid-year; last bars a gap down below the MA50 from just under the high.
High early, gap-down decline, a second leg down to a low, eight months of a weak range below the falling MA200; decision bar a wide down bar after a short rally.
Rally from a low, volatile range, surge to a spike high, decline, recovery toward the high, then a sharp drop to the rising MA200 at the decision bar.

Nine months of a slow low-volatility uptrend, then two large up gaps on record volume (about +40%) followed by a tight flat range; the flat post-gap behaviour resembles a pending-acquisition pattern rather than trend continuation.
Early dip, then a smooth year-long staircase uptrend along a rising MA50; last month a pullback from the high to just under the MA50.
Early crash wick, then a rising but volatile range with spike highs and drops; recent drop below MA200 and a final strong up bar back to it.
Low early, rally through MA200 to a spike high, decline back below MA200, base and rally to MA200; decision bars drifting down to between the MAs.
High early, steep decline (about -45%) on heavy volume, then a long volatile range of rallies and drops below the falling MA200; last bars a drop below both MAs.
Flat first five months, a steep decline (about -40%) with a double bottom, then a persistent recovery uptrend above MA200 to new year highs; MA50 crossed above MA200.
Ten-month orderly uptrend along MA50, gap up to a high, then a gap down, failed recovery, and a slide below MA50 to the rising MA200 on rising volume.
Uptrend with a dip to MA200, gap-up recovery, staircase higher, gap up to a high, then a two-month pullback below the flattening MA50 and a final up bar on volume.
Short-history stock (MA200 only recently drawn). Uptrend, spike top on heavy volume, decline, base, then a persistent seven-month uptrend to new highs; last bars a small pullback.
Large gap-up early, long orderly uptrend to a high, then a crash wick and a lower-highs decline with another crash wick on record volume; MA50 crossed below MA200; drifting at the lower range.
Early decline, base around flat MA200, then gap-led uptrend to a high, gap down, four-month sideways range around a flattening MA50; decision bar a dip below the MA50.
Early gap-down drop on high volume, recovery, gap-up rally to a top, gradual decline through MA200 to a low, sharp rally back above both MAs in the last bars.
Volatile sideways year with large swings: early drop, rally, decline with a gap down, rally above MA200, drop again; bounce at the decision point.
Top early, a gap-down collapse, a double bottom, then a seven-month steady recovery through the falling MA200 to new recovery highs with the MA50 rising.
Short-history MA200. Early dip and base, then a smooth year-long uptrend along the MA50 with an up gap; recent pullback to the MA50 and a bounce near the high.
Two deep V-shaped crashes (each -35%) separated by a recovery; second recovery back above the MA200 with a tight range at the decision point.
Rising swings to a spike top on record volume, lower second top, then a decline below MA50 and the rising MA200 to a new low; MA50 falling toward MA200.
